notes.title: The Renaissance available
notes.notes:
Oh! Hi, everybody!
Sorry for the delay in releasing Renaissance. But it's available now.

I'm very excited to introduce the new DLC for 100 Hiddensaurs. 
This DLC is about my favorite historical period, the Renaissance. Welcome to Florence, the heart of the Renaissance. Explore Santa Maria del Fiore and find all the dinosaurs.

Enjoy!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3702480/100_Hiddensaurs__Renaissance

notes.title: The Renaissance is coming
notes.notes:
Chiao! 
I'm very excited to introduce the new DLC for 100 Hiddensaurs. 
This DLC is about my favorite historical period, the Renaissance. Welcome to Florence, the heart of the Renaissance. Explore Santa Maria del Fiore and find all the dinosaurs.

I also improved the help system and added a new cursor.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Prehistoric level remastered
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We are back. Let me introduce you to the prehistoric level remaster.
The Renaissance level is coming soon.

notes.title: A new mini game was added!
notes.notes:
Oh! Hi, everyone! I'm back with a new free mini game. This is very funny ski arcade. Try it!

https://youtube.com/shorts/LI46Jysq1y0?feature=share

notes.title: Merry Christmas Update
notes.notes:
Merry Christmas! Happy New Year!
A new free level is available now! Enjoy!
Thanks to everyone who played our game! You are awesome! 
Thanks to my wife Lilya https://steamcommunity.com/id/Liliathan, she helped me with art for Christmas special level! I hope she continues to draw for 100 Hiddensaurs and others games.
Thanks to my friend Ann https://steamcommunity.com/id/ainkOink, she created adorable charming music for this game! She is game developer too. Now she is making fantastic game. You can try demo https://store.steampowered.com/app/3134890/Bunny_Space_Odyssey_FlopHop_Demo/?beta=0

It was hard year, but game making was source of happiness for me! In next year more DLC will be released! And I will start working on a new IP.

Bye! See in the next year!

notes.title: 100 Hiddensaurs - Medieval
notes.notes:
Oh! Hi, everybody!
I'm back finally. I had a lot of work on my general job. I had no time for game developing. It was very hard, but I did it. Meet a new update.

The new DLC is available now. Naughty dinosaurs went to Medieval. Try to find them all. And try a new mini game with a dragon.

The new update contents:
fix bug with medals;
increasing time for gold medal;
the sword's hilt was repainted white in DLC 100 Hiddensaurs - Greece

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3407350/100_Hiddensaurs__Medieval/

https://youtu.be/60M7Vgq6w88

notes.title: New Help System Update
notes.notes:
Oh! Hi, everyone! 
I've already completed the New Help System. 
The annoying light bulb system is a thing of the past.
Now it shows you the space where the dinosaur is.
Thank you all for your helpful feedback on my project.
And enjoy it.

notes.title: Update_2.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
New update is here!
Update includes:
Addition of progress saving,
Cursor options,
Increased time for light bulb,
Quality improvements,
Mini-games are available without a gold medal.

notes.title: New Update
notes.notes:
Oh! Hello everyone!
The first update includes:
1. Fixed background. Ptero is not blinking in the left corner.
2. Fixed URL.
3. Fixed cutscene. The opening cutscene is not shown every time you go to the main menu.

Next update announcement.
I'll add cursor options, more languages, and some visual updates.
